scope: Minimap: per-account local zoom/position, regional centering, deferred bounded scroll adjustment for WebKit, explicit viewport height and batched preference writes.

Raids: full terminal-species normal pools, independent 5% legendary/mythical category, bounded six-boss anti-repeat history and 14.25% Pokémon reward. Existing active bosses/cooldowns are preserved.
XP: both overlevel penalty factors disabled from level250; the base level ratio and all other multipliers remain. Adventure Multi Exp reserves45%.
Dark KO: independent crypto50/50 receipt per faint, account-locked atomic team/item/checkpoint writes; kits guarantee survival and Safari remains nonlethal. No retroactive recovery of old deaths.
Candies: Galaxy500000/cap400 and Universe1000000/cap600, +1level each, same bulk/ownership/cap/stock/evolution machinery.
House: default100, optional one legendary/mythical per final combined side, also applies to existing singles/doubles/PvE formats.
Tournament:3–16 entrants from either podium, random bracket/byes, sequential native singles, independent outsider PvE, automatic spectators and controller reconnection.
Equal classic money and Pokémon wagers are selected/inspected/confirmed before each played duel; byes have no charge. No XP, Adventure resources preserved.
Restart safely cancels an unfinished tournament and the existing child-duel recovery refunds active stakes. Completed duel results remain recorded.
Ties refund normal stakes; qualification uses living count, HP ratio, then secure draw.
